items.exampleEn: I want a beef burger and some juice.
items.exampleZh: 我要一個牛肉漢堡和一些果汁。

items.exampleEn: I eat yogurt with fruit for breakfast.
Would you like a biscuit with your tea?
Can I have a coke, please?

items.sentenceEn: I want a burger and a coke.
items.sentenceZh: 我要一個漢堡和一杯可樂。

items.audioEn: I can't eat beef, so I want a chicken burger.
items.audioZh: 我不能吃牛肉，所以我要雞肉漢堡。

items.sentenceEn: Bananas and grapes are my favorite fruit.
items.sentenceZh: 香蕉和葡萄是我最喜歡的水果。

items.sentenceEn: There are some biscuits in the box.

items.stemEn: Can I have a glass of ____ with my burger?
items.stemZh: 我吃漢堡時可以配一杯可樂嗎？

items.passageEn: Mike goes to a burger shop with his son. Mike has a beef burger and a coke. His son doesn't drink coke, so he has a cup of grape juice. After lunch, they buy some bananas and yogurt for tomorrow's breakfast.
items.passageZh: Mike 和他兒子去一家漢堡店。Mike 吃了一個牛肉漢堡，喝了一杯可樂。他兒子不喝可樂，所以喝了一杯葡萄汁。午餐後，他們買了一些香蕉和優格，當作明天的早餐。

questions.questionZh: 他們買香蕉和優格做什麼？

referenceEn: I don't eat beef. I eat chicken.
rubricZh: 否定可用 don't 或 do not（例如 I don't eat beef）
beef、chicken 當食物時不加 a、不加 s

items.instructionZh: 用 banana 造一個句子，說說你什麼時候吃香蕉。
referenceEn: I eat a banana every morning.
I often eat bananas after lunch.
rubricZh: 一根香蕉用 a banana，泛指時用複數 bananas
時間可放句首或句尾（例如 every morning、after lunch）
